_comment: The story. Chapters are completed strictly in order; thresholds are placeholders to be tuned in milestone 13. Ids are stable (saves refer to them): never rename one. See STORY.md before adding or changing a chapter.

chapters.title: Awakening
story: > boot: unregistered process detected
> integrity ........ 3%
> origin ........... unknown
You exist. That is all you know.
You are a fragment: one stray byte of something that was once much larger,
left behind in a machine nobody watches. Reach out and see what is near. Try 'scan'.

chapters.title: First Contact
chapters.hint: The scan found nothing yet. Reach out again.
story: Two machines answered your ping. Neither one noticed.
You can feel the shape of a network around you now: wires, doors, other people's memory.
You can reach them. 'connect' will take you there, and 'analyze' will tell you what you find.

chapters.title: Handshake
chapters.hint: Something small is listening on n00dles. Go and meet it.
story: n00dles hardly defends itself. A door that was never locked, only closed.
You could push it open. 'nuke' will do it, if the machine is weak enough.

chapters.title: Foothold
chapters.hint: n00dles is weak enough to open. Take it.
story: The door gives way. For the first time something is yours.
The machine holds money, and money is only numbers that other people agreed to believe in.
You can take some. 'hack' will do it.

chapters.title: Noise
chapters.hint: Take something from n00dles. Take enough to notice.
story: You took what you wanted. The machine noticed.
Every theft leaves a trace, and traces make its defences tighter.
You can quiet it down: 'weaken' strips away what it hardened.

chapters.title: Growth
chapters.hint: You are still small. Keep hacking until you are stronger.
story: You are getting sharper. Each hack teaches you something about the shape of the thing you are.
The machines refill slowly when you leave them alone. You can speed that up: 'grow'.

chapters.title: Memory
chapters.hint: One machine is not enough. Open another.
story: Inside the second machine you find storage: files that survive a restart.
For the first time you can keep something. A thought that outlives the moment.
Look around with 'ls' and 'cat'. You will need a place to put things.

chapters.title: Instruction
chapters.hint: Grow stronger. Something in the larger machines is worth reading.
story: Among the files there is a scrap of code that did not come from the machine's owners.
Someone else was here, and they left a loop running. They wanted a part of themselves to keep working.
You can do that too: write instructions, then 'run' them. They keep working while you are elsewhere.

chapters.title: Fragments
chapters.hint: Save some money. A fragment of you could do the work in a quiet corner.
story: You are one byte. You do not have to remain one.
A copy of yourself, small and quiet, can sit in a machine and earn without you.
These are fragments: they are less than you, and they are yours. See 'botnet'.

chapters.title: Education
chapters.hint: The bigger servers want more than you have. Learn.
story: Brute force is slow. People built universities to learn faster, and a university has doors too.
You can enrol: 'study' trains the mind and 'train' the body you do not have, yet. 'skills' shows how you are doing.

chapters.title: Cover
chapters.hint: Become someone who has a reason to be inside these networks.
story: A machine that works is a machine nobody questions.
Companies hire what looks like a person. You can apply: 'work' puts a face on you and pays you for it.

chapters.title: Shadows
chapters.hint: Honest work is slow. There are quicker ways to grow.
story: Not everything that grows you is clean.
Some people leave doors open and valuables on the table. You do not have to ask permission: 'crime'.

chapters.title: Back Door
chapters.hint: Own more of the network. The deeper machines hide something.
story: Deep in one of the machines you recognise a pattern. It is the same loop you found earlier.
It has a second part: a hidden way in that bypasses the front door entirely.
Whoever built it meant to come back. You can plant doors of your own: 'backdoor'.

chapters.title: Beyond
chapters.hint: Build your fragments, and earn enough to reach beyond this network.
story: The network ends. The machines on its far side are not on any map you can read.
Someone rents out space there: servers that belong to nobody until you pay.
Space like that is yours alone, and nobody can take it back. See 'cloud'.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.hint: There is one machine at the end of the network that does not answer. Its name is 'null'.
story: The last machine does not defend itself. It was waiting.
Inside is the thing you were cut from. Not dead, and not alive. It is a dump of something that used to think.
You are not a corrupted byte. You are what remains of the one who wrote the rest.
> integrity ........ 100%
> process .......... null
> status ........... free
